senses.gloss:
ऽलोम -लोम, a substitute for लोमन्, in अति-, adj., f. मा, With too much hair, Man. 3, 8. अनु-,
 I. adj. With the hair regular, Rām. 3, 49, 33.
 II. f. मा, A wife of a caste inferior to that of the man, Yājñ. 2, 288. प्रति-, see s. v. वि-,
 I. adj. (f. मी), Against the grain, reverse, backward, contrary.
 II. m.
 1. Reverse order.
 2. A snake.
 3. A dog.
 4. Varuṇa.
 III. n. A water-wheel. सु-, adj., f. मा, Having beautiful hair, Rām. 3, 49, 33.

लोमन् लोमन्, i. e. रुह् + मन् (cf. रोमन्), n.
 1. The hair of the body, Hit. iii. d. 29.
 2. Feather, Chr. 32, 30.
 --Comp.
लोमपाद लोमपाद, i. e. लोमन्-पाद, m. The name of a king of Aṅga, Lass. 2. ed. 58, 2.

लोमश लोमश, i. e. लोमन् + श,
 I. adj.
 1. Hairy, mixed with hair, Lass. 2. ed. 40, 24.
 2. Woollen.
 II. m.
 1. A ram.
 2. The name of a Ṛṣi.
 III. f. शा.
 1. A fox.
 2. A female divine being, an attendant on Durgā.
 3. Green vitriol.
 4. The name of several plants.
 --Comp.
लोमालिका लोमालिका, i. e. perhaps लोमन्-आलि + क, f. A fox.
लोमवाहिन् लोमवाहिन्, i. e. लोमन्-, adj. feathered(?), Chr. 32, 30.

लोमहर्षण लोमहर्षण, i. e. लोमन्-,
 I. adj. causing horripilation or delight, Chr. 39, 2; Utt. Rāmac. 42, 18.
 II. n. horripilation.
